sections.title: The Pivot Joint (The 'No' Joint)
points: Definition: Allows the rotation of one bone around its own axis.
Location: Found in the neck between the first and second vertebrae.
The Bones: The Atlas (first vertebra) and the Axis (second vertebra) work together.

sections.title: The Gliding Joint (The Slider)
points: Definition: Two relatively flat bones slide or glide over each other.
Locations: Found in the Wrists (between carpals) and the Ankles (between tarsals).

sections.text: Sutures are immovable joints that keep the skull rigid to protect your brain. Do not confuse them with movable joints!

cards.mnemonic: Think of a Pivot like a spinning tire axle!
Flat bones Glide like skates on ice!

cards.fact: The neck vertebrae that form the pivot joint.
cards.mnemonic: The Atlas holds the head, the Axis lets it turn!
